sloka: मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव ।कः समर्थो अधिकम् कर्तुम् कृत अन्तस्य इव तिष्ठतः ॥२-२१-९॥
transliteration: mayā pārśve sadhanuṣā tava guptasya rāghava ।kaḥ samartho adhikam kartum kṛta antasya iva tiṣṭhataḥ ॥2-21-9॥

translations.english: O Rama who can commit excesses on you, when you stand like Yama, god of death, protected by me with my bow?
